title: The Kingdom Transformation Mandate
paragraphs: We will talk about this during the next few sessions. This is how the word reform should really be pronounced. To rephrase something. This is the essence of the transformation from the Kingdom's perspective. It's about fixing the planet. I want to start this session with an important statement that I want you to write down. Write it down. The most powerful global policy on earth today is the pressure for compliance. This is a very serious statement. Global politics in today's world is about pushing for compliance.

As you know, countries have policies, companies have policies, and even some families have policies put in place at home. But I'm talking about a major policy that concerns the entire planet. The global policy that prevails in the world today is the pressure for compliance. This leads me to my second point. Write this down. Globalization is a movement of compliance. Repeat after me. Globalization is a movement of compliance. Globalization says that everyone must comply with the same things. Get in line or leave.

Be like everyone else or don't be at all. That is globalization. To point number three, which is extremely important. The goal of globalization is for all countries, all societies, all cultures, all peoples, and all groups to comply with a single global system. That was not the original intention of the United Nations. The United Nations was formed to prevent wars. She has now changed her goal to something more dangerous. It is compliance.

Therefore, the goal of globalization is to ensure that all countries, cultures, groups, and societies comply with the same systems. I want you to listen to me carefully. This is extremely dangerous. Write down point number four. Compliance requires giving up your convictions, values, beliefs, principles, morals, and distinctive traits. Compliance eliminates individuality. Compliance says: "Forget what you believe. You must accept what we believe." Compliance means forgetting what your culture considers to be true.

"You must accept our culture." Therefore, compliance eliminates excellence. So, to comply means to relinquish your own importance. You are erasing what makes you different. You are giving up what makes you unique. This is a dangerous proposition. But it is happening now in every nation. Therefore, we have some other issues. I call it the compliance agenda. Without noticing. The whole world is in what I call a state of constant change. Everyone is struggling with this change.

But the challenge is that the world is changing, yet they are moving away from some things. What are they staying away from? First, they are moving away from what we call traditional values. They are moving away from traditional ethical standards. They are moving away from traditional systems. They are moving away from what we call traditional cultural norms. What we have considered normal for the past five thousand years, they are moving away from. They are also moving away from what we call traditional beliefs.

They are moving away from traditional rules. They are breaking the rules that we have accepted as time-tested rules. A very dangerous world. So, this is what they call change. For them, change is a departure from these principles that we have lived by for over 6000 years in terms of time. This is the generation you live in. You live in a generation that tinkers with things that ancient Egypt never touched. The Canaanites did not pay attention to it. The Babylonians never doubted it. The Romans never dealt with it.

The Greeks never tried to change it. This generation we live in is extremely dangerous. It literally touches on things that no other civilization has touched. Of course, some of the things they claim to be changing to are actually outdated. And so, this is the world we live in. They are moving away from traditional laws. Now, it is important to understand that we live in this world. This is the world we should go to school into. We must go to work there. We need to start a business there.

We need to employ people there. We must build houses there. This is a dangerous world. Let me move on to my third point, which I call the pursuit of change. Humanity is pursuing change with a recklessness that seems deliberate and insane. The goal of the contemporary movement for global social change is to move away from these time-tested principles. They are violating time-tested values established by the Creator. In other words, they are seeking change. In what we call our postmodern world.

They are even prepared to violate. Natural law. This is dangerous. They... and I say "they", I don't know who I'm talking about. Because somehow they are everywhere. But it seems they have gone mad across the generations. To the extent that they attempt to make changes that disregard natural law. Of course, you cannot ignore natural law. But we are trying to do that. In other words, change is inevitable, but it should never be at the expense of principles. The principles are permanent and unchanging.

Man did not create the principles. Humans did not invent natural law. Humanity is not the source of spiritual law. However, we are trying to make changes in our world while ignoring and violating these time-tested principles. The question is, will you stand idly by and allow that to happen? The problem is that if you do nothing about it, you will become a victim of it. Either you leave the planet or you live under these changes. Now, here is what I call the divine development strategy.

God, the Creator, has something to say about this matter. I will present these ideas to you. Please write it down. Firstly, humans were created to continue creating, but not by violating the Creator’s inherent laws of creation. This is a profound statement. I want you to write it down and think about it for a week. First and foremost, it is very clear that God created you to be creative. Creation is not yet finished. God has finished his role. On the seventh day, God said, "This is good. I will rest from my work."

But if you read the Book of Genesis, after God said, " I have rested from my work," God said to mankind, "Work." Man was given his ability and his spirit, and he was given the strongest power on earth, which is the mind and the will. He said to man, “Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and have dominion over it.” I thought God was finished. God says, “No, I give you the property. You build on it. I provide the property. You construct on it.

And I want you to build on it according to my specifications and architectural design. I want you to build my kingdom on earth, and I want you to dominate the earth with the influence of my kingdom. This is your project.” God has entrusted you with a task and given you all the equipment you need. He gave you material possessions, He gave you materials, He gave you a mind, thought, will, and intelligence, and then He did the most important thing, which is that He gave you His soul. He says, " Go, my children.

Show me what you can do." Nothing makes a father prouder than seeing his children continue the work he started. Am I right? When your child takes on your project and completes it better than you, how do you feel? The parents don't want to do everything. Their joy is seeing their children take it to the next level. God says: "I want humans to take this planet that I have given them and organize it, arrange it, restructure its arrangements and give it order."

Incidentally, the word "paradise" in Genesis does not refer to vegetables and oranges. The Hebrew word for "paradise" simply means, write it down, it means order. order. God took man and placed him in a spot on earth where order prevailed. Then God said, "Multiply this order and fill the whole earth with order." You know, the word paradise was used because if you think about it, what's the difference between paradise and the jungle? Both contain plants. The difference is that one of them has what? order.

The other one has no system. Some people's lives are like that. They are jungles in clothes. There is no order in their lives. They grow randomly. All kinds of wild animals nest in their lives. God says, "I want order." I want this to be an organized place. I want everything to be done properly and in an orderly fashion. This is why the term control or sovereignty was used. The matter is related to the ruling. The government brings order. That's what is assumed. Now, number two. The Creator anticipates growth.

Progress was anticipated. But he predicted it within the context of divinely ordained natural and spiritual laws. God was very clear with Adam. You are free to eat from any tree in Paradise. This is a blank check. But he closed it by saying, "Except," he drew a simple line there. In other words, God will never give you unlimited freedom. There must be some kind of restrictions to maintain your system. In all of God's creation, He set limits for everything. You read the Bible a lot, don't you? We hope so.

The Bible, throughout the Old and New Testaments, always says that the sea cannot exceed its limits. Are n't we Bahamians in the Bahamas grateful? You should thank God for that. A tsunami is not a natural occurrence because the sea misbehaves. A tsunami occurs when the sea breaks the law. How long have you been living in the Bahamas, Jamaica, or Barbados? Thank God that the sea is still where you left it, where you wanted it to be. God has placed laws at the very core of creation.

These laws are deeply rooted, let everyone say deeply rooted. Please, now, remember that word. It's an important word. Inherent means that you had no involvement in it. correct. There are things I found here just as they were. You cannot change it. You cannot vote to cancel it. Amen. You cannot remove it by praying. You cannot remove it by fasting. You cannot impose your opinion on her. These rules were set by the manufacturer internally. I want you to think about it the way you think about your car.

When you bought your car, you didn't make it. I went to the showroom and the car was there. It wasn't your production. When I bought the car, the instruction manual said: "If you want this car to work, put unleaded gasoline in the tank." Now, you have your own will. You can form a committee to vote against using gasoline in your car. You could actually conduct a referendum on whether you should put gasoline in your car. The referendum may already be passed that you will no longer put petrol in your car.

I changed the law. I decided to use top-grade Florida orange juice. No problem. And so you vote, you win the vote, you go to town, and you buy the biggest gallon of orange juice, rich in vitamin C and everything in it. Pour it into the tank. The problem is that the mechanism of operation using gasoline is inherent. It was placed inside. Therefore, you cannot change an inherent law by your will. Ford's will disregards your will.

Therefore, if you want your car to work, you should always pray like this: " Not my will, but Thy will be done, O Lord." How do I look so far? Look, in other words, some of us believe that we can pray against the will of the Creator. The disciples asked Jesus: "How do we pray?" Jesus said, " Simply. Learn how to pray. Here's how to pray: Our Maker who is not on earth." In other words, these products did not come from the earth. I was sent to Earth. The manufacturer isn't even from here.

The word father means source. If your car is a Ford, then its source is Ford. So, Ford is the father of your car. The word father means source. But it also means provider, which means that Ford also determines how the car works. Not just the fact that she made it. It is the source and the provider for that car. You have to do what Ford tells you to do for the car to work. Jesus says that God is our Father, but where is He? In the sky.

This means if you want to mess with anything on Earth, you should consult Heaven first. If something on the floor breaks, you should consult the factory to repair it because only the factory has genuine spare parts. Therefore, if the social, economic, cultural, educational and political systems are not working on the ground, do not ask for a consultant from the ground. Jesus said, "When you ask, first identify the source of our factory, which is in heaven." He says: "Now, you must respect him."

Sacred means that you respect His name. In other words, the name on your car is Mercedes, don't ignore that. Oh, that's very deep. You have a Mercedes parked in the parking lot. You'd better respect the Mercedes name. This is a sacred name for your car. Because if you tried to put a Toyota part in that car, some of you took your cars to an unauthorized dealer under a tamarind tree. Is anyone here talking to me? And you wonder why the car is worse than it was when you first bought it.

That's because the unauthorized dealer ignored the sacred name on your car and bought a replacement part or maybe went to the junkyard. Let's not talk too much about it, and he found an old car with a part that looked similar. Now, the Bible says that Satan comes as an angel of light. It looks similar. It's best for you to know the difference. Clap for God. It's best for you to know the difference.

There are people in high positions who will look appropriate, speak appropriately, and even have an appropriate appearance and smell. It's best for you to make sure they are genuine spare parts. The Creator expects growth, but it must be within the context of His laws. In other words, when you talk about change, it should always be done within the context of the inherent rules established by the factory. At least point number three. Please repeat it aloud after me.

True change is growth and development within the limits of inherent, natural, and spiritual laws. Note that I used the word real change. Many of the changes we go through and think about are not real changes. Yes. As you know, it's like me, as a man, going through an operation to become a woman. They remove my penis and make a small incision where it was, and they say they performed gender reassignment surgery. The only problem is that they didn't put a uterus there. So, I'm simply a man with a wound.

In other words, it is not a fundamental modification but a cosmetic one. Hallelujah. This is a serious matter, as you know. God says: “ Look, I want you to grow, I want you to progress, I want you to develop. I have commanded you to fill and populate the earth, of course. But not by violating my inherent natural and spiritual laws.” This is what God says. The earth was not designed to function without the sky. This is addressed to individuals and nations.

Whenever you are about to make a decision in your work, in your relationship, in your marriage, in your life as a teenager, I want you to think first. Which of God's laws does this violate? That's your first idea. Let me tell you, don't miss the next session I'll be giving later. But listen to me. God has placed a mechanism within every human being to trigger an alarm when they are about to break a law. It is a built-in mechanism. You do not need a preacher, a priest, a bishop, or an apostle.

God has placed an innate mechanism within the human system that works automatically. It is called conscience. You know when you make a mistake. Hello. Nobody needs to tell you that. You know when you're driving to the beach with someone you're not married to and you're about to park behind bushes. You don't need a holy anointing. There is an alarm. Beep beep beep. to stop. to stop. Turn around. Take them home. Beep beep beep beep. But you ignore the warning. It also works when you eat too much.

You know, isn't there someone who says that gluttony is a sin? Just like adultery, gluttony is also a sin. So, when you know you're full, the system tells you to stop. But you look at the plate while your conscience tells you to stop. Your eyes overcome your conscience. And when you finish, you say that you have become lethargic. That is not idleness. That is sin. Are you following along with me? Believe me, everyone who makes a mistake knows that they are making a mistake.

Anyone who is about to vote for the wrong law knows that they are voting for the wrong law. You don't need anyone to tell them that God has put in place a built-in mechanism called conscience. If you always obey your conscience, you will never feel regret. Think about it. You always regret violating your conscience. You have to live with that regret. Therefore, God has innate laws. Therefore, write it like this: Natural and spiritual laws are protected by conscience and by morality. Creation protects it.

Do you see? Creation protects itself, as you know. If you try to disturb nature, nature will turn around and disturb you. This happens all over the world. You know, when you go drilling for oil, right? The oil has been stable there for 5000 years, calm and gentle. Now, don't misunderstand me. I am neither for nor against oil exploration. I am simply presenting you with genuine principles here. Well, the oil is in its place and the fish have been swimming on top of it for 1000 years, there is no problem.

And the coral reefs are happy. Now, you decide that I will pierce this cavity. This is what oil exploration means. It is a hole in a cavity that is under pressure. First, you must consider: Am I prepared to deal with the potential consequences if things get out of control when I pierce it? And what will nature do to me if I violate this conscience? Am I ready? Last week, the world's second-largest oil company pleaded for mercy. Some of you have heard about this this week.

They said, "If we continue to pay the required compensation, have you listened to the news or will you listen to me again in this news?" They said, "We may have to stop working." These people have billions and billions. They said, "Yes, but as you can see, we made a mistake and the cost could force us out of the market." My point is this: God has set laws in nature. Respect those laws. Your body, for example. You know, someone asked me that day, "So, Brother Miles, what do you think about oral sex?"

It's a big question people ask me all the time, you know, about everything oral sex. And I say, "Well, you know, that's a tough question." Because your mouth is meant for eating.” Oh, you’re all smiling at me. I can leave it at that. Wow. If you don’t know the purpose of something, you’ll misuse it. Creation protects itself. And God has placed a conscience in the order of the world and in our social system. Conscience protects God’s laws.

And when you do something wrong, your conscience will haunt you for the rest of your life. There are people sitting in this room today watching this program who are still trying to get rid of things they did 50 years ago. Conscience has a way of keeping them alive. We thank God for the blood of Jesus, which cleanses us. But it doesn’t erase them completely. That’s why I tell young people: Do what’s right so you don’t regret your memories. God’s laws were never made to restrict or oppress you.

They were made to protect your memories. If you live a good life, you’ll enjoy everything you remember. That’s why we need the forgiveness of Jesus Christ. It cleanses us so our memories no longer affect us. Forgiveness does n’t erase memories. It takes the pain out of them. Now, let me take you to this change side. So, when we talk about Change—we must be careful. First and foremost, in order to progress, develop, and prosper, we must change. You cannot do what God says without making some change.

God is not against change. God is the God of change, even though He Himself never changes. God has never repeated a miracle. He is always creative. He loves innovation, but He will never break His own law to innovate. Innovation is very interesting. People think that innovation means creating something entirely new. No, there is nothing new in this room. You will never buy a truly new pair of shoes. That's impossible. It's impossible to buy a completely new dress. Impossible.

It's impossible to buy a new pair of shoes or a new suit. It's impossible to buy a new house. It's impossible. Why? Because everything on Earth is simply a new combination of old things. Your shoes, which you say are new, are actually made from an old cow. Am I right? Here you are, going into the store excited about these $60 shoes. And they are actually made from an old cow. In some cases, they are less than a cow; they are plastic. They are petroleum derivatives. They are not new.

They are probably more than 10 million years old. But you You call it new because someone reassembled it in a different way, that's all. There's no such thing as a new house. It's just rocks and cement. It's been around for years. But someone put it together in a new way, and we call that innovation. God says, "Look, I'm not against you creating new things." But you can't do that by breaking my laws." So, change requires looking at what's right here. Let's talk about the danger of change.

Everyone's thinking that civil society needs improvement. Oh yes, have you heard those terms lately? Oh, your nation needs to get into the modern world. Or your people are backward. Let me ask you a question. Oh. Look, I need to find someone who owns an old house. Is there anyone who's lived in their house for more than 20 years? Let me see your hands. You've lived in your house for 20 years. Okay, can I ask you a question? You're smiling right now because you're on TV. Okay. How long have you been in that house?

More than 30 years. Okay. You've stayed in one house for 30 years. Okay. Eh... Have you altered the foundation? We've never touched it. Hmm. But you've changed the furniture. Yes, you've painted it, improved it, upgraded things in it, the plants and everything, but you've never touched the foundation. So, that means you can actually upgrade things without Touching its foundations? Hmm. Can you actually move forward without moving certain things? Yes. Ah, interesting. So, you have new furniture on an old foundation?

Yes. Can you put up brand new curtains in a house with an old foundation? Hmm. Wow. So, that means you can move forward without touching the foundation. Okay. That 's our challenge. To identify the foundations. Our societies, our countries, must realize: what are the foundations? So that we don't touch things that can't be moved. All real change must happen within the bounds of natural and spiritual laws. I hope I've made that point clear enough. And this, for me, is a sign I've shown you before. I like this sign.

It shows me what the world looks like now. Let's say the words together. What 's the first word? Lost. The second? Confused, uncertain, unclear, impoverished. Lost, bewildered. That's the state of the world now. And I tell you, not all change is an improvement. Not all change is progress. Not all change is evolution. Change will happen to everything. But here's the paradox. Change is only possible where there is something constant. And I've made that point before, And I'm emphasizing this now.

You can't change unless you know where the permanent foundation is. In other words, we have to be careful about what we change. Not everything has to change, and some things are made to stay unchanged and as stable as the foundation of that house. You can change the windows from old ones to modern, hurricane-proof shutters. But don't touch that foundation. Otherwise, the government will deem the house uninhabitable. You don't want God condemning your country because you messed with its foundation.

You can work on equality between men and women. You can work on, you know, no child abuse. You can work on, you know, uh... marriage between a man and a woman. You can work on lots of things. But there are some things you shouldn't touch. And this generation seems to be defying God, saying, " We're going to change what you say can't be changed." And God is warning us, "I will condemn your building." In other words, never confuse change with growth.

I'm going to conclude this concept today because I want you to go and think about this for a while. Everyone say: growth. It's not Change. Don't confuse the two. Let me explain. I have a picture of a lighthouse here for a reason. A lighthouse is an amazing structure. A lighthouse never moves. Only ships move. And a lighthouse doesn't move because it protects ships. If a lighthouse floated like humanism and secularism, your ship wouldn't be able to sail the ocean. Humanism says there is no absolute truth.

Please, all of you, listen to me carefully now. I want you to think about this before you leave. Humanism and secularism make humans the judges of what is right and wrong. Humanism says humans have the power to decide what is good, bad, just, fair, right, wrong, high, low, acceptable, and unacceptable. Which means we've actually become a fickle society. A lighthouse protects us because it doesn't move. And anyone here in this room who's a sailor will tell you they depend on that lighthouse all the time.

They pray that the lighthouse will always stay in place because that lighthouse tells them where to go and where not to go. Yes, sir. Ah, you missed that. A lighthouse tells you where you are. But also the places you shouldn't go. Don't go in that direction you're going as a nation. Why? The lighthouse points to that rock over there. You know, we somehow think we're smarter than God. But God is the lighthouse. He said, "This is the truth." "That's right." And we say to God, "No, we've improved recently."

We're a little smarter than that, you know." We've become more modern." And God says, "Yes, but you can't move the lighthouse." The principle is like the lighthouse, and that's why these are the things you must never change. Write them down. Don't forget them. I'm going to give you the key to life for the next 50 years. Write them down. These are the things you must never change, and you will live a successful life. Number one, you must never change the principles. The precepts are original ideas from God.

Second, you must never change the principles. The principles are what they call the First Law. The word " principle" means first. And a principle means the First Law. Third, you must never change the purpose. The purpose of a thing is permanent. How old is your car? 25 years. Good. So, can you now use it as a boat? No, because the purpose of a car doesn't change over time. The purpose is permanent. You're wearing a blouse, right? You've had that blouse for 50 years. Does it transform into something else?

No, it continues to serve the purpose for which the blouse was made. In other words, you don't touch the purpose. What is the purpose of my rectum? Excretion. So, you don't change its purpose. It can't change. Your eye won't hear anything. Never. Am I right? Your mouth will never smell anything. The purpose is permanent. When God creates something, the purpose is specific. Your feet will never become a hand, even if you try to use them as a hand. They will never be a hand. The purpose is permanent.

What else do n't you change? Fourth, never change a natural law. It never changes. You can't change a natural law. Plants grow in soil. Plants need sunlight, period. It's a permanent law. It's a natural law. Fifth, never change the truth. The truth is original information. Write that down. The truth is very practical. For example, when you buy a television, there's a book inside the box. We call it the user manual. The user manual is the truth about the product.

That's why it doesn't come from the retailer or the wholesaler. All the truth comes from the manufacturers. Oh my God, this is very important. Look, we keep trying to get the truth from customers, retailers, and wholesalers. Don't trust any of them. They don't know this product. That's why the manual comes in the box. Yes, sir. The manufacturer doesn't write manuals. Sorry, I mean the wholesaler doesn't write manuals. The manufacturer does.

That's because the manufacturer is the only one who knows the truth about the product. That's why when you buy a product and it does n't work, they always say in the manual, " Send it back to us at our expense." Don't touch it. If you open it, they say, "We'll void the warranty." So, never touch the truth. You know, Jesus Christ—that final statement of Jesus's was the intended meaning. I am the path to the truth that gives you life. "That's why he said that." "I am the path to the truth that gives you life."

In other words, "I am the creator of everything on this planet." I made it myself. If you want it to work for you and give you life, you must get it from me. Get the information from me. That is why I preach the kingdom. That is the information he provided. It is the truth, the kingdom, as he says. Who will hear me? Do you know, Pilate was a Roman governor. The Romans were humane. They adopted Greek philosophy. They believed that they were the absolute truth. On the day of the trial, Christ stood before Pilate.

Pilate began by asking him: " Are you a king?" Jesus replied, "Yes, I am the king." He says: "For this purpose I was born, to be a king." Then he says: "I have come to bear witness to what is right." "That's a profound statement." And everyone who hears me says, "He hears the truth." Pilate replied in confusion: " What is right, anyway? " Look, even Pilate was not confident in his own teaching. He knew there was a problem with Greek philosophy. He knew there was a problem with the Roman perspective.

He knew that this was not right. Something wasn't right. Jesus said, "What is truth, man?" "I am still searching for it." "Please tell me what it is." Christ says: "I am the way. " "And I am the Truth." "I am life." Do you want to live? Get the information from me because I am the manufacturer. I know my products. That's why we need Jesus. I said that this is why we need Jesus. You need Jesus Christ not to go to heaven. You need it to live on Earth to get through this confusion, these misconceptions about life.

You need it to give you the right. Never change the truth. Number six, never change the roots. What is the origin of things? Number seven, never change the fundamentals. Number eight, never change the source. And number nine, you can never change the spiritual laws. It's permanent. Whether you use it or not, it works. And number ten, you must never change your conscience. Conscience is permanent. It exists. It's ingrained and you can't even silence it.

You can shout at your conscience, and it will shout back at you. You can try drinking alcohol, but it will still be there when you wake up. Yes, sir. You can sleep and take pills, and when you regain consciousness, your conscience will say, "I am here." It's permanent, and you can't change it. That's why you should make your conscience your best friend. Because he is the only friend who never leaves and always talks to you. You cannot change these things.

Remember this list, and when you are about to make decisions in your life, take it out. I want you to go home and print this list onto your computer. I want you to print it out and put it in your office, in your warehouse, in your car, put it on the mirror where you groom your face and comb your hair, put it in your wallet, make a small card out of it and write the name " Miles Monroe" on it, make sure to give me credit, and distribute it. Give it to everyone, and tell them that this is your way of life.

Live according to these ten things and you will have a good life. This is how you protect yourself, young people. This is how you protect yourself, old woman. I am talking to you, not to the person directly behind you. Don't take it personally. Good. Look at that list. Consider living according to that list. You can't be wrong. Let me give you an example before we pray. Here is a picture. I love this picture. A fish can never grow outside the confines of water. Now, the fish are growing, are n't they?

Therefore, growth is not change. The fish grows, but it never changes its environment. Because the environment is the source of its life. What does the list say? You cannot change your source. The source of life for fish is water. So, even if a fish grows to ten feet long, it grows and changes during its growth phase, but it can never outgrow its source. I have never seen a fish say to me: I am fed up with the water. I will go ashore today. Fish can never get tired of water. There are inherent, unchanging laws.

You don't change your source. That is why Jesus says, " What is God?" father. The word for father is "Abba" in Hebrew. It means source. You cannot grow beyond your source. I don't need God. Oh, you'd better keep quiet. In fact, God calls the person who denies His existence ignorant. The reason is that God says that the very breath you use to say that belongs to me. So, you must be an idiot. God is patient with your foolishness. It lets you say whatever you want until you become aware of yourself. It is the source.

Look at this. This is this picture. Look at that tree. I searched for that tree on my computer via the internet. They say this tree is over 500 years old. But it cannot leave its roots. No matter how old you are, no matter how mature you become, and no matter how much you think you are growing up, you can never abandon your roots. There are things you cannot change. Well, as you know, my father and mother believe in God, but now I've gone to university, and I know a little more.

It would be better for you to keep quiet and return to the God of your father. We have people who go to university, study something simple, and forget about it, and I went through that too.
